syllabus_extract: Principles of fuel quantity measurement. Practical & Demonstration
specific_objectives: 15.1.7.1 Trainee will be able to explain Principles of fuel quantity measurement indicator.

Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of fuel quantity indicator operation; Safety: Ensure aircraft is grounded and fuel caps secured; Supervision: Instructor monitors trainee observation of float mechanism movement.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the fuel quantity indicator?
List two common types of fuel quantity measurement systems.
Why is accurate fuel measurement critical for flight safety?

Describe two factors that can cause inaccurate fuel quantity readings.
Outline the steps for verifying fuel quantity before engine start.
